High-level summary
- Small Python project that provides a CLI generator and an MCP server to create "slash" command definitions for various AI assistants. See [README.md](README.md) for overview and quick start.

Key packages & entry points
- CLI app: [`slash_commands.cli.app`](slash_commands/cli.py) — CLI implemented with Typer ([slash_commands/cli.py](slash_commands/cli.py)).
- Writer/orchestration: [`slash_commands.writer.SlashCommandWriter`](slash_commands/writer.py) — loads prompts and writes agent-specific command files ([slash_commands/writer.py](slash_commands/writer.py)).
- Agent configuration: [`slash_commands.config.AgentConfig`](slash_commands/config.py), [`slash_commands.config.get_agent_config`](slash_commands/config.py), [`slash_commands.config.list_agent_keys`](slash_commands/config.py) ([slash_commands/config.py](slash_commands/config.py)).
- Auto-detection: [`slash_commands.detection.detect_agents`](slash_commands/detection.py) — detects installed agents by scanning configured directories ([slash_commands/detection.py](slash_commands/detection.py)).
- Generators: [`slash_commands.generators.MarkdownCommandGenerator`](slash_commands/generators.py) and [`slash_commands.generators.TomlCommandGenerator`](slash_commands/generators.py) — produce Markdown and TOML command outputs ([slash_commands/generators.py](slash_commands/generators.py)).
- MCP utilities: e.g. [`mcp_server.prompt_utils.parse_frontmatter`](mcp_server/prompt_utils.py) — prompt parsing and MCP helpers ([mcp_server/prompt_utils.py](mcp_server/prompt_utils.py)).
- Server entry point: [server.py](server.py).

Testing & fixtures
- Tests live under [tests/](tests/) with key files: [tests/test_cli.py](tests/test_cli.py), [tests/test_generators.py](tests/test_generators.py), [tests/conftest.py](tests/conftest.py). Docs claim a full test suite with ~79 passing tests and ~85% coverage (see docs/artifacts).

Packaging, build & release
- Project metadata and release config live in [pyproject.toml](pyproject.toml). Semantic-release config is included under [tool.semantic_release] (refer to docs artifact: [docs/artifacts/comprehensive-issue-resolution/task-1-semantic-release-config.md](docs/artifacts/comprehensive-issue-resolution/task-1-semantic-release-config.md)).
- Build system: Hatchling-based configuration (see build notes: [docs/artifacts/0002/task-2.0/build-system.txt](docs/artifacts/0002/task-2.0/build-system.txt)).
- Release workflow and GitHub auth artifacts: automated semantic-release workflow example ([docs/artifacts/0002/task-1.0/release-workflow.txt](docs/artifacts/0002/task-1.0/release-workflow.txt)) and Chainguard STS config ([docs/artifacts/0002/task-1.0/chainguard-config.txt](docs/artifacts/0002/task-1.0/chainguard-config.txt)).

Dev tooling & CI
- Pre-commit and ruff configured; debugging shows pre-commit run output in artifacts ([docs/artifacts/0001/task-4.0/task-4.0-pre-commit-run.txt](docs/artifacts/0001/task-4.0/task-4.0-pre-commit-run.txt)).
- Dockerfile for containerized builds uses uv and uv.lock ([Dockerfile](Dockerfile)).
- README contains common dev commands (tests, coverage, build): [README.md](README.md).

Documentation & artifacts
- User and developer docs: [docs/slash-command-generator.md](docs/slash-command-generator.md), [docs/operations.md](docs/operations.md), [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md).
- Proof artifacts and task traces are under [docs/artifacts/](docs/artifacts/) (examples: semantic-release task [docs/artifacts/0002/task-1.0/README.md](docs/artifacts/0002/task-1.0/README.md), comprehensive completion summary [docs/artifacts/comprehensive-issue-resolution/COMPLETION-SUMMARY.md](docs/artifacts/comprehensive-issue-resolution/COMPLETION-SUMMARY.md)).

License & metadata
- Apache-2.0 license present: [LICENSE](LICENSE).
- Release notes & changelog: [RELEASE_NOTES_v1.0.0.md](RELEASE_NOTES_v1.0.0.md), [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md).

Quick commands (from README)
- Run tests: uv run pytest — see [README.md](README.md)
- Build: uv run python -m build — see [README.md](README.md)
- Run server: python server.py — see [README.md](README.md) and [server.py](server.py)
